issuer: the Ministère des Transports et de l'Aviation Civile
note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshots of 30 August 2026 of the Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation's own site (transports.gouv.ne), its page 'e-services/permis-conduire' and the script that page loads, which holds its text (PermisConduire-Drzr1GKa.js). It says: validity 5 years for categories A and B, 3 years for C and D; minimum age 18 for category B, 16 for A; and the fees of an application: dossier 5,000 FCFA, theory examination 10,000, practical examination 15,000, 'Fabrication du permis' 20,000, total 50,000 FCFA. The fee is null: the form holds one issuing fee, and whether the licence's own fee is the 20,000 FCFA manufacture alone or the 50,000 FCFA total is my reading either way. The page is an online application form; no decree or arrêté setting these amounts was read. No later snapshot than 30 August 2026 was looked for.
